title: A body changes
hook: One animal passes through different forms.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The schematic compares a tadpole with a later frog form: legs appear and the tail becomes reduced. This is a simplified example; amphibian development varies across species, and not every species has a free-swimming tadpole.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: In a familiar frog life cycle, what changes as a tadpole develops toward a typical adult frog?
